pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, predominantly polygonal geometry with varying spatial area. Darker, more defined patches are concentrated along the upper flank and neck, exhibiting moderately sharp pixel gradients at the edges, while ventral patches appear smaller and less saturated.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pelage forming clear topological intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the upper flank, with three-way junction nodes predominating the grid structure.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck line, characterized by low-amplitude, high-frequency tufts of the mane contrasting against the background vegetation.
